title: Sustainable Investment Decision-Making on Office Buildings using Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 把办公楼全生命周期可持续投资决策建成序贯优化
contributions.mechanism: 将设计/施工/运营决策建为 MDP,用 Deep Q-Network 训练,把 ESG 影响货币化进奖励;γ=e^-r 对齐经济折现率,MORL 处理成本-碳权衡
contributions.evaluation: US/UK 案例:能耗降 37.5-45.0%、全周期碳降 31.0-36.9%;首年成本 +4-6% 但生命周期成本降 $0.42M(US)/£1.01M(UK)
contributions.domain: AI 成本工程/可持续建筑投资
contributions.source_quote: Sequential choices across design, construction, and operation are modeled as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and trained with a Deep Q-Network.

contributions.purpose: 检验 RL 策略的稳健性
contributions.mechanism: ±20% 参数噪声与 +2°C 气候情景下的敏感性/鲁棒性测试
contributions.evaluation: 社会成本 NPV 在噪声下 -$3.40M±0.45M、升温情景 -$3.75M(优于常规 +$0.50M);SCC $50→$300 使收益变动 -24%~+16%
contributions.source_quote: Results remain robust under ±20% parameter noise and a +2°C climate scenario.

contributions.purpose: 用 LLM 打通非结构化指南与利益相关者沟通
contributions.mechanism: ChatGPT-5 抽取参数、生成学习策略的自然语言解释;并给出 NPV-RL 等价性与线性标量化 Pareto 支持两条命题
contributions.evaluation: LLM 解释被自动评分:准确性 92%、相关性 94%、可行动性 89%、数值一致性 90%
contributions.source_quote: A large language model (LLM), ChatGPT-5, is used to extract parameters from unstructured guidance and to generate stakeholder-facing explanations of learned policies.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Methodologically, the study moves beyond static LCCA/MCDA by casting decisions as sequential and uncertain, using a weight-conditioned MORL view of cost–carbon trade-offs.

notes: 数据红旗:所谓 US/UK‘case studies’实为随机模拟(参数取自 Table 1),全部结果为合成数据、非真实楼盘(自认‘shown in simulation but not yet on live procurements’)。内部数字矛盾:摘要称社会成本 NPV 降 $3.50M(US)/$3.00M(UK),但 §3.1 正文写‘Societal cost NPV decreases by $12.00M’(US)与‘£7.19M’(UK),数值自相矛盾。循环自评:LLM 解释由 ChatGPT-5 自动打分(Table 6 89-94%),自认‘auto-scored rather than expert-audited’。Proposition 1/2 实为 DCF/标量化 Pareto 的平凡改写。作者署名‘ChatGPT-5, OpenAI’(虚构单位)+ 人类合著。trade-off:首年成本 +4-6%;社会估值依赖二手乘数。accept。
